[LDIA.1.1] A **dialect** is a name for a setting of every capability in
the registry of [LCAP.1] to `true` or `false`. A dialect is not itself a
capability. Dialect names and capability names are separate namespaces, so a
dialect may share a capability's name, as the built-in `realtime` dialect
does ([LDIA.9.3]).
